name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente; reserve a cup of pasta water.
Meanwhile, gently sizzle sliced garlic in olive oil until golden, then add chili flakes.
Toss pasta through the oil with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Serve with grated parmesan.

name: Margherita Pizza Toast
steps: Spread tomato sauce on the bread slices.
Top with torn mozzarella and basil, drizzle with olive oil.
Grill or bake at 220C for 5-7 minutes until bubbling.

name: Classic Cheese Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with milk and a pinch of salt.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in eggs, stir gently until just setting, add cheese.
Fold and slide onto a plate.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in hot oil and set aside.
Stir-fry peas and spring onions for 2 minutes.
Add cold cooked rice, toss until hot, then soy sauce.
Fold the egg back through and serve.

name: Chicken and Veg Stir-Fry
steps: Slice chicken thinly; marinate in half the soy sauce for 10 minutes.
Sear chicken in a screaming-hot wok until cooked through; remove.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger and broccoli for 3 minutes.
Return chicken, add remaining soy sauce, toss and serve over rice.

name: Simple Tomato Pasta
steps: Soften diced onion and garlic in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add canned tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Toss with cooked penne and torn basil.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter the outside of both bread slices.
Sandwich the cheese between them, butter-side out.
Cook in a pan over medium heat 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.

name: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, sugar and baking powder; whisk in milk and eggs until smooth.
Rest the batter 5 minutes.
Ladle into a buttered pan, flip when bubbles appear, about 2 minutes per side.

name: Easy Chicken Curry
steps: Brown the chicken pieces and set aside.
Soften onions and garlic, stir in curry powder until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk, return chicken, simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over rice.

name: Hearty Vegetable Soup
steps: Soften onion, carrots and celery in oil for 10 minutes.
Add potatoes, tomatoes and stock; simmer 25 minutes.
Season well and serve with crusty bread.

name: Tuna Pasta Bake
steps: Cook penne until just tender; drain.
Mix with tuna, tomatoes and sweetcorn; tip into a baking dish.
Top with cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the beef with diced onion, 8 minutes.
Stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water; simmer 5 minutes.
Fill warm taco shells with beef, lettuce and cheese.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Season and sear chicken 6 minutes per side; rest and slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing.
Top with chicken, parmesan shavings and croutons.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion and pepper, add spices and cook 1 minute.
Pour in tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Crack in eggs, cover and cook 6-8 minutes until whites set.

name: Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni; drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then gradually whisk in milk until thick.
Stir in most of the cheese until melted, combine with pasta.
Top with remaining cheese, grill until golden.

name: Red Lentil Dahl
steps: Soften onion and garlic with the spices for 5 minutes.
Add lentils and 750ml water; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk, season, serve with rice or naan.

name: Soy Fried Eggs over Rice
steps: Fry eggs sunny-side up in a hot oiled pan until edges crisp.
Spoon over hot rice.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil, scatter spring onions.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop cucumber, tomatoes and onion into chunks.
Combine with olives, top with a slab of feta.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and season.

name: Chili Con Carne
steps: Brown beef with onion; add chili powder and cumin.
Add tomatoes and beans; simmer 30 minutes.
Serve over rice with sour cream if you have it.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Crisp the bacon in a pan; cook spaghetti until al dente.
Whisk eggs with parmesan and plenty of pepper.
Toss hot pasta with bacon, then the egg mix off the heat, loosening with pasta water.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Soften onion, add curry powder and cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer 15 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach, season and serve with rice.

name: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs, milk and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Soak bread slices 30 seconds per side.
Fry in butter 2-3 minutes per side until golden.

name: Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Shred the cooked chicken; dice the pepper.
Fill tortillas with chicken, pepper, cheese and salsa; fold.
Cook in a dry pan 3 minutes per side until crisp and melted.

name: Miso Soup with Tofu
steps: Simmer stock; add cubed tofu for 3 minutes.
Whisk miso with a ladle of hot stock, then stir back in off the boil.
Serve scattered with spring onions.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Soften onion, carrots and garlic for 10 minutes.
Brown the beef, breaking it up.
Add tomatoes, simmer 30 minutes. Serve over spaghetti.

name: Quick Pad Thai
steps: Soak noodles per packet; sear sliced chicken until cooked.
Push aside, scramble eggs in the wok.
Add noodles, soy sauce and a squeeze of lime; toss.
Top with crushed peanuts.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Halve peppers and remove seeds.
Mix rice, beans, tomatoes and half the cheese; fill peppers.
Top with remaining cheese; bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring stock to a simmer; whisk in cornstarch slurry.
Drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring to form ribbons.
Serve with spring onions.

name: Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Simmer soy, honey and grated ginger until syrupy.
Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes; flip, brush with glaze.
Serve over rice with extra glaze.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella thickly.
Alternate on a plate with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt.

name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the garam masala for 20 minutes.
Sear chicken until charred at edges; set aside.
Simmer tomatoes, garlic, butter and remaining spices 15 minutes; blend.
Stir chicken through the sauce; serve with rice or naan.

name: Avocado Toast with Eggs
steps: Toast the bread.
Smash avocado with lemon juice and salt onto the toast.
Top with fried or poached eggs and chili flakes.

name: Upgraded Instant Ramen
steps: Cook noodles per packet; add peas for the last 2 minutes.
Soft-boil eggs separately for 6.5 minutes.
Assemble with soy sauce and spring onions.

name: Chicken Cobb Salad
steps: Chop chicken, bacon, eggs and avocado.
Arrange in rows over lettuce.
Dress with vinaigrette or ranch.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Sear mushrooms until golden; set aside.
Soften onion, add rice and toast 2 minutes; deglaze with wine.
Add stock a ladle at a time, stirring, 20 minutes.
Stir through mushrooms, parmesan and butter.

name: Fish Tacos
steps: Season fish with paprika and salt; sear 3 minutes per side.
Warm tortillas.
Fill with fish, cabbage, sour cream and lime.

name: Thai Green Curry
steps: Fry curry paste in a spoon of coconut cream until fragrant.
Add chicken; coat in paste.
Pour in coconut milk, add veg; simmer 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Easy Lasagna
steps: Brown beef; add tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes.
Layer sheets, meat sauce and ricotta in a dish; repeat.
Top with mozzarella; bake at 190C for 30 minutes.

name: Salmon Poke Bowl
steps: Cube salmon; toss with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Assemble over rice with cucumber and avocado.
Finish with sesame seeds if you have them.

name: Shepherd's Pie
steps: Brown lamb with onion and carrots; add peas and a splash of stock.
Boil and mash potatoes with butter.
Top the meat with mash; bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Hummus Veggie Wrap
steps: Spread hummus over tortillas.
Layer sliced veg and lettuce.
Roll tightly and halve.

name: Korean Beef Bowls
steps: Brown the beef.
Add garlic, ginger, soy and sugar; simmer 5 minutes until sticky.
Serve over rice with spring onions.

name: Minestrone
steps: Soften carrots and celery in oil 8 minutes.
Add tomatoes, beans and stock; simmer 20 minutes.
Add pasta; cook until tender. Serve with parmesan.

name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss sliced chicken and veg with seasoning and oil.
Sear in a hot pan 8 minutes until charred.
Serve in warm tortillas with lime.

name: Egg Fried Noodles
steps: Cook noodles; drain.
Stir-fry veg 3 minutes; push aside and scramble eggs.
Add noodles and soy; toss everything together.

name: Bruschetta
steps: Toast the bread; rub with cut garlic.
Dice tomatoes; toss with basil, oil and salt.
Spoon onto toast and serve immediately.

name: Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Sear chicken thighs until cooked through.
Simmer soy, honey and ginger until syrupy.
Glaze the chicken; slice and serve over rice.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Pasta
steps: Wilt spinach with garlic.
Stir in ricotta and a splash of pasta water.
Toss with penne; finish with parmesan.

name: Slow Beef Stew
steps: Brown beef in batches.
Add veg and stock; bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook low 2 hours until tender.

name: Cauliflower Chickpea Curry
steps: Soften onion; bloom curry powder.
Add cauliflower, chickpeas and coconut milk.
Simmer 20 minutes; serve over rice.

name: Tuna Melt
steps: Mix tuna with mayo and seasoning.
Pile onto bread; top with cheese.
Grill until bubbling and golden.

name: Veggie Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry carrots and peas 3 minutes.
Add rice; toss until hot.
Push aside, scramble eggs in, add soy and spring onions.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer chicken in stock 15 minutes; shred.
Add carrots, celery and noodles; cook 10 minutes.
Return chicken; season and serve.

name: Burrito Bowl
steps: Warm the beans and sweetcorn.
Assemble over rice with avocado and salsa.
Squeeze over lime if you have it.

name: Pesto Pasta
steps: Cook spaghetti; reserve pasta water.
Toss hot pasta with pesto, loosening with water.
Add halved tomatoes and parmesan.

name: Sausage Traybake
steps: Chop everything into chunks; toss with oil and salt on a tray.
Roast at 200C for 35-40 minutes, turning once.
Serve with mustard.

name: Coconut Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer coconut milk with ginger 5 minutes.
Add chicken and mushrooms; cook 12 minutes.
Finish with lime juice and salt.

name: Ratatouille
steps: Soften onion and garlic; add chopped veg.
Pour in tomatoes; simmer 30 minutes until silky.
Serve with crusty bread or over polenta.

name: Chicken Alfredo
steps: Sear sliced chicken; set aside.
Simmer garlic and cream 5 minutes; whisk in parmesan.
Toss with fettuccine and chicken.

name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Soften onion with cumin.
Add beans and stock; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend half for body; serve with lime.
